paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: The influence of number of blanks to .
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the accuracy percentage of the Qwen2.5-VL-72B model as a function of the number of blanks, with the x-axis labeled “# Blanks” ranging from 1 to 6 on a linear scale and the y-axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” ranging from 0 to 60 on a linear scale. The plot features a single blue line with circular markers, representing the model’s performance. At the start of the x-axis (1 blank), the accuracy is 60%. As the number of blanks increases, the accuracy decreases sharply, reaching 20% at 2 blanks, then 10% at 3 blanks, and dropping to 0% at both 4 and 5 blanks. The accuracy remains at 0% for the final point on the x-axis (6 blanks).
